about_text: My name is Lenny Winnemuller, based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. I graduated with honors in psychology at the University of Amsterdam (specializing in group behavior), and also hold a degree in entrepreneurship. I've worked as a professional in the financial markets in the Netherlands and Canada. Today I invest independently besides teaching long-term investing in the Canadian trader education program Peak Capital Trading.
